summary: Full E2E test (backend + frontend UI) of the premium cancellation flow with OPTIONAL reason, as requested. All 3 scenarios (skip reason / predefined reason / 'other' + free text) pass end-to-end: backend returns 200 {ok:true}, MongoDB premium_cancellations stores correct reason values ('not_specified', 'too_expensive', 'other'+detail), premium is correctly deactivated, and the premium screen reverts to the subscribe/upsell view. The two-step modal flow (confirm -> reason) and the 'Zostan przy Premium' keep-button (no API call, premium stays active) also work correctly. Backend pytest suite (6 tests) all pass. No bugs found in this feature.
action_items: No action needed - the previously-flagged bug (reason being required and blocking cancellation) is confirmed FIXED. Feature is working as specified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py premium_cancel: correctly maps raw_reason -> recognized key as-is, unrecognized/non-empty text -> 'other', empty/missing -> 'not_specified'. Clean and matches spec.
GET /api/admin/cancellations returns {total, by_reason, recent} (grouped-by-reason shape) which satisfies the 'grouped by reason' requirement nicely - better than a flat list.

frontend premium.tsx: confirmCancel() sends reason: reason || undefined (not empty string), so skipping reason truly omits the field rather than sending ''. Matches backend's Optional[str]=None contract.
reasonModalSubtitle copy correctly communicates optionality: 'Twoja opinia pomoże nam ulepszyć aplikację (opcjonalnie — możesz też pominąć ten krok).' - verified visible in UI screenshot.
No client-side validation blocks confirmCancel() when reason is null - confirmed by successful Scenario A tap-through with zero reason rows selected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 E2E cancellation scenarios + keep-premium flow passed via Playwright)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created ~4 TEST_cancel_* users (prefixed TEST_, safe to ignore/cleanup later). Frontend Playwright run reused existing seeded user ania_t1@test.pl (subscribed/canceled premium multiple times across scenarios - net end state: premium inactive, which is fine for a demo/test account). Added several premium_cancellations documents for both test users and ania_t1@test.pl (reasons: not_specified, too_expensive, other) - harmless test artifacts, no production data affected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL, which doesn't exist in this repo's .env) for backend base URL in tests/scripts. pytest.ini forces '-n 2 --dist loadscope' (cannot be overridden) - when writing module-scoped fixtures shared across test classes in the same file, put all dependent tests in ONE class, since loadscope pins fixture-sharing per class and different classes can land on different xdist workers (separate Python processes = separate fixture instances), which caused flaky failures until consolidated.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found - this was a verification pass confirming the previous agent's fix for the 'reason required' bug. Verified via: (1) Playwright clicking 'Potwierdź rezygnację' with zero reason rows selected -> no reasonError shown, API call succeeded (200), premium-active box disappeared, subscribe button reappeared. (2) Re-subscribed, selected 'Za drogo' (too_expensive) row, confirmed -> succeeded. (3) Re-subscribed, selected 'Inne', typed free text into the now-visible TextInput (testID premium-cancel-reason-detail), confirmed -> succeeded. (4) Cross-verified via direct admin API call (logged in as ADMIN/Test@123) that GET /api/admin/cancellations 'recent' list contains ania_t1@test.pl's 3 new entries with exact reason/detail values matching what was clicked in the UI, confirming true frontend->backend->MongoDB integration (not just backend-only correctness). (5) Verified 'Zostań przy Premium' (keep) button closes the first modal without opening the reason modal or calling any API, and premium remains active afterward.
